title: Walnut Salad with Walnut Crust
description: A light and refreshing salad topped with a crunchy walnut crust. Perfect for a spring evening.

ingredients.name: showoff
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley

instructions: In a food processor, grind the walnuts into a coarse crumb.
Add the crushed walnuts to a bowl and mix in the chopped herbs.
In a separate pan, heat the walnut oil over medium heat.
Add the blue cheese to the pan and stir until melted.
To assemble the salad, place the silky greens on a plate and top with the walnut crumble.
Drizzle the melted blue cheese over the salad and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional chopped herbs if desired.
